single.rationale: Dauch faces deteriorating fundamentals with revenue declining 4.7% YoY, operating margin collapsing to 1.9% (from 4.0% prior year), and returning to net losses. The $1.4B debt increase from the Dowlais acquisition significantly increases leverage risk, while 72% customer concentration (GM/Ford/Stellantis) and heavy Mexico exposure create material execution and tariff risks that outweigh the modest FCF yield.
